AAA Championships - C/Pal - 13/14 July - ERNEST OBENG 100m CHAMPION:- Third in 1978, second in 1981 and now first in 1985, Ernest Obeng has become only the second Belgrave runner to win a Senior AAA title by taking the 100m championship this year (his only predecessor being Bill Nankeville who won the Mile in 1948).

The entertainer Bobby Davro presented some of the awards and he introduced his father Bill Nankeville. Bill was with Belgrave for a time after the war and his name can be found on our Internationals Board at the Hall.
